events.title: First General Meeting
events.summary: Kick off the semester with CISA! Meet the club and e-board, hear what's planned, and connect with other students.
events.description: Special guest presentation: Cyberdeck Demonstration by Abington alum Pavlo Krykavskyi — see a custom-built Cyberdeck in action and learn how it was created.

events.title: Come Hack — Hands-on Cybersecurity Practice
events.summary: Biweekly hands-on session: learn how real systems are attacked, defended, investigated, and analyzed. Laptop recommended; workstations available.
events.description: Led by Moussa Toure. Guided learning plus practical labs on cyber ranges (TryHackMe, OffSec Labs, Hack Smarter, PortSwigger) and custom-built labs. No prior experience required.
